description: SIW+ is SIW with IW+ in place of IW: it reaches the goal one drop in the goal count `#g` at a time, running IW(1), IW(2), … up to `max_k` for each step. At the root of each IW run it computes a relaxed plan once, and the `#r` of a node counts the plan's facts, not true at that root, that its path has reached. IW+ keeps one novelty table per value of `#r`, so it prunes a state only if it brings nothing new among states with the same `#r`, and it often reaches a subgoal at width 1 where SIW needs width 2. Unlike LAPKT's SIW+, this version does not keep the goals it reached, skip duplicate states or stop widening early, so plans and node counts differ. Use it when a relaxed-plan oracle is at hand and SIW needs too large a width.

papers.title: Width-based Algorithms for Classical Planning: New Results
papers.venue: ECAI 2014 (Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications)
